faqs.q: Is TradeWeave AI safe, legit or a scam?
faqs.a: We found no scam indicators in the product, which reads as a functioning AI trading service. The conditions are editorial: claims without verification, conflicting figures and restriction lists that disagree. We rate it safe to research with the conditions in this review.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.
Yes - signup is free and activates through a confirmation link. The first cost is the US$300 deposit, which stays in your trading balance.

faqs.q: What happens after I sign up?
faqs.a: You confirm the account by email, fund US$300, set your risk preferences and choose automatic or manual mode. The demo account runs alongside while you learn.

bottomLine: As a product, TradeWeave AI offers the expected setup and nothing that breaks. The issues sit in the published claims, and the claims are avoidable if you trade the minimum.
We rate it 4.8 with conditions: the platform is usable, the published claims are not all verifiable, and the US$300 minimum is the right size for testing either.
